subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: Source confirms stale visible copy, but the reporter's proposed label differs from current official Google Cloud wording and the stable provider id should not be renamed casually.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update UI/provider/docs labels to current Google wording while keeping the stable `google-vertex` id and config surface unchanged.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Match the reporter's requested wording even though it is not the exact official wording found in current Google Cloud pages.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave the current label until maintainers decide the Google rename is settled enough for OpenClaw docs and UI.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update UI/provider/docs labels to current Google wording while keeping the stable `google-vertex` id and config surface unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the clearest recent history on the provider display/docs surface and is already called out in the live issue discussion for the wording decision.
